features.description: Private runtime lifecycle and policy lifeline
acceptance_criteria: AC1: reproduce official v0.54.4 policy leak with positive fixture PIDs/PGIDs and clean only those fixture processes.
Implement same-executable run detection, bounded versioned private stop/receipt transport, early registration and descriptor rollback.
Preserve admission fd3; add separate policy worker lifeline, nested cleanup acknowledgement and no admission after stop.
Test malformed/oversized/forged receipt, supervisor loss, policy timeout/output/credential/provenance invariants and supported-platform guards (AC3–5).
features.notes: M1 committed 1fbc6f992 and integrated: marker-backed official v0.54.4 leak; same-file private bounded lifecycle, admission fd3 preserved, worker lifeline. Full tests, policy suite, focused races and lint passed.

acceptance_criteria: RequestStop starts bounded protocol cancellation; Join requires inner cleanup receipt, direct Wait and owned I/O completion under one owner deadline.
Managed and two async policy workers vanish before successful cancellation; quit/EOF and natural completion join ownership (AC2–3).
Missing acknowledgement produces typed failure; forced supervisor death stops inner worker, unrelated bystander survives (AC4).
Existing external-command and platform cancellation behavior remains covered; race tests pass.
